2940463815.detail_html:
Embark on a multi-sensorial escape room adventure across 13 rooms and 4 story chapters.

The Armoury

The soldiers’ living quarters bear witness to the secret and intimate conversations between soldiers. Get a close in on the inexplicable and peculiar mysteries surrounding the seemingly innocent common military spaces. You and your team are about to find out that the nondescript bunk holds a dark and sinister secret. One warning though, leave the place before it’s too late!

The Basement

Dark, dank and hidden from the rest. The Basement is the perfect place to conceal a gruesome tragedy. Someone or something twisted and depraved lurks below. There is imminent danger to anyone who poses a threat to its existence. Your investigation team must orchestrate a heart-pounding escape fast through the twists and turns of the Basement before it is too late.

The Medical Centre

Step inside the Medical Centre where accidents and emergencies are dealt with. This facility holds the answers to the unimaginable horrors and experiences faced by the soldiers during the previous mission. It is up to you and your team to get to the bottom of the mystery and gain a searing insight into their plight. Can you escape before the mind-blowing and grueling revelation destroys the last strands of your sanity?

The Research Lab

Time is ticking, and the reactor will blow up in the matter of minutes! The contamination has begun and soon it will be impossible to undo the mistakes of the science team that has mysteriously vanished. The Head Scientist in charge of the laboratory has a strange fascination that she is trying to hide… Your investigation team has been assigned to power down the reactor in time and find out her secret before the inevitable happens. It is a race against time.

Terms & Conditions

• All players are advised to arrive 15 minutes before their scheduled timeslot.

• Players below the age of 12 are advised to be accompanied by an adult.

• Facility will have intense sound effects, use of strobe effects and fog/smoke effects.

• Ticket sold is non-transferable, non-refundable and void if altered.

• Singapore Discovery Centre may, without prior notice and without refund or compensation or any liability, change the operating hours, close and/or restrict admission to the centre and attraction(s) due to capacity, inclement weather, special events or any other reasons.

13805399796.detail_html:
Viltrox AF 28mm f/4.5 Overview

The Viltrox AF 28mm f/4.5 for Sony E-mount cameras is a classic lens offering the perfect focal length for street photography. Thanks to its ultrathin and lightweight design, the lens remains almost unnoticed, which is beneficial for obtaining candid shots. When presented with a backlit situation, the lens produces a starburst effect that transforms light rays into spiky beams. An innovative aspect of this lens is the integrated cap, which opens and closes via a slide lever, eliminating worries of losing the cap and providing better protection against dust. Additionally, the lens is protected by multilayer nanocoating that prevents dust, oil, and water damage.

About this item

* Compact Prime Lens:

The VILTROX 28mm f4.5 FE lens is a compact, lightweight prime lens designed for Sony full-frame mirrorless cameras. 60.3mm in diameter and 15.3mm thick, and weighs only about 60g.

Wide-Angle Perspective: With a 28mm focal length, this lens offers a versatile wide-angle perspective, ideal for landscapes, architecture, and environmental portraits.

* Precise Focusing:

The lens features a multi-layer coating that minimizes ghosting and flare, ensuring sharp and clear images.


 

USB Upgrade Port: The lens is equipped with a USB upgrade port, creating more opportunities for compatibility with the continuously evolving E-mount cameras.

* Durable Construction: Crafted with a metal lens barrel, this lens is built to withstand the rigors of daily use and travel.

Inbuilt Lens Cap: The lens is protected via an inbuilt lens cap that you slide to open and close.


 

Key Features

Full-Frame | f/4.5

Starburst Effect

Ultrathin and Lightweight

Autofocus Design

Cap Forms Part of the Lens

Multilayer Nano Coating

13804676790.title: Medela Harmony Flex Manual Breast Pump / with Essential Kit - Made in Switzerland
13804676790.detail_text: Medela Harmony Flex is a single manual breast pump, perfect for mums who express occasionally and need a lightweight travel companion. Now with the Flex technology. It is perfect for busy schedules, as a backup to your electric pump, or for occasional use if you normally breastfeed your baby. Small enough to fit into your handbag and with no need for batteries or wires, mums love their on-the-go hand pumps. • Made in Switzerland • Compact, light and portable: take the Harmony™ anywhere you go. • Discreet & quiet: pump with it confidently anytime and anywhere. • PersonalFit Flex™ breast shields: for increased comfort and more milk. Shield size is 24mm • 2-Phase Expression technology: its unique handle helps you mimic your baby’s natural suckling rhythm2,3. • Simple to use: intuitive and ergonomic design. • Easy to clean: stripped-down assembly and disassembly, also washing and sanitizing Harmony™ is child’s play. Harmony is a single, manual breast pump designed for occasional time away from baby. The best selling manual breast pump. Light and discreet: switch between this pump and a double electric pump or use this pump on its own if you do not pump frequently Elegantly designed and comfortable to use: assembly is intuitive and the pump has an ergonomic twist handle Features 2-Phase Expression technology: proven to produce more milk in less time. What is 2-Phase Expression Technology? Through research, Medela learned that there are two distinct phases of how babies breastfeed. Stimulation phase – When babies first go to breast, they suck fast and light to stimulate milk flow.

product.desc:
Medela Harmony Flex is a single manual breast pump, perfect for mums who express occasionally and need a lightweight travel companion. Now with the Flex technology.



It is perfect for busy schedules, as a backup to your electric pump, or for occasional use if you normally breastfeed your baby. Small enough to fit into your handbag and with no need for batteries or wires, mums love their on-the-go hand pumps.





• Made in Switzerland



• Compact, light and portable: take the Harmony™ anywhere you go.



• Discreet & quiet: pump with it confidently anytime and anywhere.



• PersonalFit Flex™ breast shields: for increased comfort and more milk. Shield size is 24mm



• 2-Phase Expression technology: its unique handle helps you mimic your baby’s natural suckling rhythm2,3.



• Simple to use: intuitive and ergonomic design.



• Easy to clean: stripped-down assembly and disassembly, also washing and sanitizing Harmony™ is child’s play.





Harmony is a single, manual breast pump designed for occasional time away from baby.



The best selling manual breast pump.





Light and discreet: switch between this pump and a double electric pump or use this pump on its own if you do not pump frequently





Elegantly designed and comfortable to use: assembly is intuitive and the pump has an ergonomic twist handle





Features 2-Phase Expression technology: proven to produce more milk in less time.





What is 2-Phase Expression Technology?



Through research, Medela learned that there are two distinct phases of how babies breastfeed.



Stimulation phase – When babies first go to breast, they suck fast and light to stimulate milk flow.

13789825860.detail_text: Retro Design The Water Moon Rain Old Fashioned Open-Back Retro Small Portable HiFi Wired Headphones offer a unique retro design that sets them apart from modern headphones. High-Fidelity Sound These headphones are designed for audiophiles, delivering high-fidelity sound that brings your music to life with crystal-clear clarity. Portable Size Their compact and lightweight design makes these headphones easy to carry around, perfect for music lovers on the go. Headset Comfort These headphones are designed for comfort, with a headband that distributes weight evenly, reducing pressure on your head during long listening sessions. Wired Connection The wired connection ensures stable and uninterrupted audio transmission, providing an optimal listening experience.
